name: Brick Duel
hook: Break bricks to wreck your rivals' boards.
how: Everyone plays their own brick breaker side by side. Smash a glowing brick to hit a rival with a faster ball, a smaller paddle or junk rows. Lose all your balls and you're out; last board standing wins.
controls: Mouse or ← → to move, click or Space to launch; on touch, drag to move and tap to launch
uses: You watch every rival's board, ball and paddle as they play.
The host's browser runs the match: who is out, the winner, the restart, and which rival each attack hits. If it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats, play their own boards and send attacks too.
ideas: Add a laser power-up that shoots bricks
Let me pick which rival my attacks hit
Make the bricks candy and the ball a gumball
